app.title: DreamTale AI
app.tagline: Magical bedtime stories in your voice

language.restartNeeded: Restart the app to finish changing the text direction.
language.restartManually: Close and open the app again to finish changing the text direction.

auth.switchToLogin: Already have an account? Log in
auth.forgotText: Enter your email. If it has an account, we send a link to choose a new password.
auth.linkSent: If this email has an account, a link was sent. It works for 30 minutes. Check your spam folder too.
auth.passwordsDiffer: The two passwords are not the same.
auth.passwordShort: The password must have 8 or more characters.
auth.resetDone: Your password was changed. You can log in now.
auth.resetInvalid: This link is not valid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.fillAll: Enter your email and a password of 8 or more characters.

settings.title: Settings
settings.voiceSample: Once upon a time, a little star wished you a good night.
settings.voiceError: Could not play a voice on this device.
settings.voiceNote: "Read aloud" uses your device voice. You can also record yourself reading any story.
settings.deleteMessage: This deletes your account and all your stories. It cannot be undone.

create.keywordsHint: Add up to 10 ideas, like a name, a place or an animal.
create.keywordsFull: You can add up to 10 ideas.
create.torahHint: The story stays true to the source and is told gently for children.
create.needKeyword: Add an idea or describe the story.
create.loadingNote: This can take up to two minutes.
create.torahNotFound: We could not find a Torah story for these ideas. Try a name or a story, like Noah.
create.dailyLimit: You reached today's story limit. Try again tomorrow.
create.cancelNote: If you stop, the story may still be saved. Check your library.
create.storyLanguageHint: The app text stays as it is. A Hebrew story is written with nikud (vowel points).
create.childAgeHint: The words and the story are fitted to this age.
create.lengthHint: About how long it takes to tell it aloud.
create.promptHint: Optional. Write what you want in your own words, even a whole sentence.
create.promptPlaceholder: For example: a shy dragon who learns to share cookies with his friends

story.parentGone: This story was deleted, so there is no next chapter.
story.noVoice: This device has no voice for this language.
story.voicesEmpty: No one has recorded this story yet. Read it aloud in your own voice, and your child can hear it any time.

library.emptyAll: No stories yet. Create your first one!
library.emptyFavorites: No favorites yet. Tap the heart on a story you love.
library.deleteMessage: This cannot be undone. Next chapters stay in your library.

record.title: Read this story aloud
record.consent: The person reading agrees to be recorded, and that the recording is kept in this app.
record.consentHint: You can delete the recording at any time.
record.tips: Find a quiet room. Read slowly and calmly, like at bedtime. The story is shown below.
record.needConsent: The person reading must agree first.
record.noPermission: We need the microphone to record. Allow it in your phone settings.
record.failed: Could not record. Please try again.
record.tooShort: That was too short. Please read the story.
record.tooBig: The recording is too big, or there is no storage left.
record.tooMany: This story already has the most recordings it can have. Delete one first.
record.badFile: We could not use this recording.

clone.title: Read in a cloned voice
clone.intro: A voice is a short recording of someone reading. With it, the computer can read English stories in that voice. Only you can use your voices, and you can delete them at any time.
clone.noVoices: You have no voices yet. Record a short sample of someone reading, and the computer can read this story in that voice.
clone.slowNote: This can take several minutes. You can leave this screen. The audio is made in the background.
clone.deleteVoiceMessage: The voice sample and all the audio made with it will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
clone.scriptHint: Read this text out loud, calmly and clearly. Read all of it, at least {{min}} seconds.
clone.sampleTooShort: That was too short. Please read all of the text (at least {{seconds}} seconds).
clone.consent: The person speaking agrees that the computer copies their voice to read stories, and that the voice sample is kept in this app.
clone.consentHint: You can delete the voice at any time. Never copy a voice without the OK of that person.
clone.needConsent: The person speaking must agree first.
clone.voiceLimit: You already have the most voices you can have. Delete one first.
clone.englishOnly: A cloned voice can read English stories only, for now.
clone.dailyLimit: You made the most audio you can make today. Try again tomorrow.
clone.tooLong: This story is too long to make into audio.
clone.notAvailable: Voice cloning is not set up on this server.

errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.validation: Please check the details you entered.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries. Please wait a little.
errors.timeout: This is taking too long. Please try again.
errors.serviceBusy: The service is busy. Please try again soon.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
